warning_texts: No machine rule in audit/check_plan.json compares the question text an answer file restates with raw_data/questions.md, so a narrowed question passes questions_are_answered whenever the 'question' field is present; this auditor is the only check on it.

The spec period ends 2025-03-30, one day short of calendar Q1, while metrics name the period '2025-Q1-delivered' and R01 says 'reported quarter'; the raw export has no row dated 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but the label is the spec's to confirm.

CLM-REFUND-RATE counts a customer as refunded when any delivered in-period order has refund_amount > 0, partial refunds included (e.g. O00050, 69.80 of 279.21); the caveats say the denominator is paying customers but do not say that a partial refund makes a customer 'refunded'.

R04 restates 'under which of the spec's allowed exclusions' as 'under which rule'; its caveats name both allowed exclusions, so the substance is answered, but the restatement is looser than the question.
